# Public API Inventory

<!-- Generated by ./gradlew generatePublicApiInventory. Do not edit manually. -->

This file freezes the currently visible source-level contract per published artifact using the [Public API Boundaries](public-api-boundaries.md). Packages containing `domain`, `port`, `api`, or descendants of those segments are supported by convention. `adapter`, `application`, `autoconfigure`, `internal`, `serialization`, `service`, and build logic are implementation by default. Documented package and type exceptions are consumer API. Infrastructure types are public for framework wiring. Public internal types require review and are not supported extension points.

## Maintenance

Regenerate after an intentional public surface change:

```bash
./gradlew generatePublicApiInventory
```

Validate that the checked-in baseline matches the source and property references:

```bash
./gradlew validatePublicApiInventory
```

Validate the reviewed classification of every top-level public type:

```bash
./gradlew validatePublicTypeClassificationBaseline
```

Validate that replaceable beans do not introduce concrete return types:

```bash
./gradlew validateConcreteReplaceableBeans
```
